menuTagline: A door learns your name one knock at a time.
difficultyEasyDesc: A calmer opening, less aggressive enemies, and more room to learn.
difficultyNormalDesc: The original experience: steady pressure, but fair.
difficultyHardDesc: Stronger enemies, fewer rewards, and more fragile sanity.
loreP1: Your grandfather never built a basement. Still, every night the house breathed below the floorboards.
loreP2: When he died, he left a toothless key, a silent recorder, and a rule written on the back of an electric bill: if the door answers, do not stop knocking.
loreP3: The wood keeps no treasure. It keeps rooms that do not fit the house plan, creatures made of old dust, and fear fragments able to buy one more dawn.
loreP4: Tonight the first door appeared in the corridor. It already knows the sound of your hand. Now it wants to learn the rest.

merchantAppeared: A merchant set a table in room {room}.
merchantHealDesc: Restores HP, recovers sanity, and lowers pressure.
merchantHealed: The merchant blew out the candle. You recovered.
merchantBundleDesc: Gives one of each common basement item.
noItem: You do not have enough of that item yet.
noRecordText: The house still pretends it is empty.
doorIntro: The first door is still learning the sound of your hand.
doorBreak: The door opened into an impossible corridor.
retreatLog: You retreated near the door. It locked again.
autoClickerText: I saw that autoclicker. Press F6 to stop it and unlock the game. If F6 gets caught by the autoclicker, click Continue. After that, you can use it normally: this scare only appears once in this save.
autoClickerReleased: Autoclicker released. The basement will pretend it saw nothing.
finalText: The thousandth door opened outward. There was no street, sky, or neighbors: only your house seen from below, hanging by roots. You knocked until the basement forgot your name. End of prototype.
finalCaption: The house went silent. For the first time, it did not answer.
finalLog: Room 1000 was beaten. The house released your name.
damagePaused: The house holds its breath while you read.
upgradeRecorderDesc: Deals automatic damage and records echoes.
upgradeCandleDesc: Reduces incoming damage and restores sanity.
upgradeMirrorDesc: Gain extra fear when enemies fall.
storyFirstKnockText: The wood answered one second too late.
storyCorridorText: The first door opened. Beyond it, rooms breathe in sequence.
storyNameText: Scratches on the wall repeat your name when you stop looking.
storyDeepText: The basement is not below the house. The house is trying to get off it.
